derived.label: Finish substrate
derived.basis: Microcement requires a rigid, dimensionally-stable substrate; troweled over bare plywood it flexes and the coating crazes. Cement board is the backing.

derived.label: Core ring width
derived.basis: Set equal to the 3 in underside reveal band so continuous backing sits behind the full width of the finish-bearing underside (backing invariant).

derived.label: Torsion-box rib count
derived.basis: Fewest ribs keeping every bay (6.562 in) below the 8 in flex threshold for a 3/4 in finish-bearing deck.

derived.label: Corner joinery
derived.basis: A mesh-reinforced butt corner under a continuous coating is stronger than a mitered one; a miter opens a hairline the microcement telegraphs.

derived.label: Excluded fastener
derived.basis: Drywall screws snap under the head in cement board. Wafer-head cement-board screws are specified instead.
